Subject: Notice for intimation of discrepancies in the return after scrutiny for the period from 01-04-2022 to 31-03-2023 (FY 2022-23).

In exercise of the powers conferred under section 61 of the CGST Act, the undersigned has noticed the following discrepancies in your return:
  1. ITC claimed in GSTR-3B does not match GSTR-2A.

You are requested to file a reply within 30 days, i.e. on or before 30-09-2024.

-- State Tax Officer, Mumbai Ward 5
